description: This file contains utility functions for detecting potential fake tensor leaks in PyTorch's export process, including reference analysis and garbage collection handling.

methods.name: _is_globals_or_locals
methods.description: Checks if an object is the current global or local namespace.

methods.name: _is_tracked_fake
methods.description: Determines if an object is an instance of torch.fx.experimental.symbolic_shapes.TrackedFake.

methods.name: _is_gm_meta_like_dict
methods.description: Checks if a dictionary's 'val' key references a specific object.

methods.name: _dict_is_attr_of_tracked_fake
methods.description: Checks if a dictionary is exactly the __dict__ of a TrackedFake object, considering Python 3.10 quirks.

methods.name: find_legit_leaks_from_referrers
methods.description: Analyzes active fake tensors to identify legitimate leaks based on reference patterns.
